ex.s: There almost are no grades, other than‘Are you working towards your goal?’ Basically, it’s ‘I’ve got to produce this product and then, at the end of year, present it to NASA.’ Engineers come and really do an in-person review, and…it’s not a very nice thing at time.

defs.def: a report in a newspaper or magazine, or on the Internet, television or radio, in which sb gives their opinion of a book, play, film/movie, etc; the act of writing this kind of report （对书、戏剧、电影等的）评介，评论

ex.s: The study used a dataset of 1,600 reviews of Chicago hotels.
ex.t: 该研究使用了1600条芝加哥酒店评论的数据集。

ex.s: The reviews were presented to 400 subjects.
ex.t: 这些评论被呈现给400名受试者。

ex.s: The results show that consumers generally trust negative reviews more than positive ones.
ex.t: 结果表明，消费者总体上更相信负面评论而不是正面评论。

ex.s: Moreover, we humans tend to assume that positive reviews might be fake.
ex.t: 此外，我们人类倾向于认为正面评价可能是假的。

ex.s: “Overall, negative reviews are less common.
ex.t: “总体而言，负面评论比较少见。

ex.s: When a negative review is fake, we get tricked,” Azimi says.
ex.t: “当一条负面评论是假的时，我们就会被骗，”Azimi说。

ex.s: A long, negative review of a hotel, complete with lots of information, tended to convince participants.
ex.t: 一条信息详尽的冗长负面酒店评论，往往能说服参与者。

ex.s: A lengthy, positive review, on the other hand, was regarded as suspicious, and participants tended to trust writers that kept their glowing reviews short.
ex.t: 另一方面，一条冗长而正面的评价被认为是可疑的，参与者倾向于信任那些保持他们热情洋溢的评论简短的作家。

ex.s: Azimi says study participants tended not to trust reviews where the writers expressed their feelings in a big way.
ex.t: Azimi说，研究参与者往往不相信那些作家们以很大方式表达其感情的评论。

ex.s: Many companies are producing fake reviews.
ex.t: 许多公司在制造虚假评论。

ex.s: Machines can detect fake reviews accurately.
ex.t: 机器能够准确地识别虚假评论。

ex.s: It will be harder to recognize fake reviews.
ex.t: 识别虚假评论将变得更加困难。

ex.s: Though wastED received enthusiastic reviews, it was designed from the start as a short-lived experiment; Blue Hill has since returned to its regular menu.
ex.t: 尽管wastED收获了热烈好评，它从一开始就被设计成短期实验；Blue Hill此后已恢复常规菜单。

ex.s: A review of modern paintings.
ex.t: 一篇现代绘画评论。

ex.s: What kind of review would readers most likely trust?
ex.t: 读者最可能相信哪种评论？

ex.s: Each subject got eight reviews to read: a balanced set of two positive fake, two positive real, two negative fake and two negative real, presented in a random order.
ex.t: 每位受试者读了八条评论：均衡地包含两条正面虚假、两条正面真实、两条负面虚假和两条负面真实，以随机顺序呈现。

ex.s: When it came to faking a review, length was important to believability, as was detail.
ex.t: 在伪造评论方面，长度对可信度很重要，细节也是如此。

ex.t: 一篇书评。

ex.t: 一篇剧评。

ex.s: Take, for example,the epic movie Tory, which is in part based on Homer’s The Iliad and was met with mixed reviews from the audience.
ex.t: 在前往行星的旅程中，它可能会受到陨石的严重损坏。

ex.s: According to the reviews, these hotels are clean, central and inexpensive.
ex.t: 根据评价，这些酒店干净整洁，位于市中心，价格便宜。

ex.s: The Little Prince BOOK REVIEW The Little Prince was written and illustrated by the French writer Antoine de Saint-Exupéry during World War II.
ex.t: 《小王子》书评：《小王子》由法国作家安托万·德·圣埃克苏佩里在第二次世界大战期间创作并绘制插图。

ex.s: Human beings have always loved reviews: word of mouth has long been regarded as one of the most valuable marketing tools available to a company.
ex.t: 人类一直喜爱评论：口碑长期以来被视为公司可用的最有价值的营销工具之一。

ex.s: While running regularly can’t make you live forever, the review says it  64 (be) more effective at lengthening life  65 walking, cycling or swimming.

defs.def: a report on a subject or on a series of events 报告；汇报；述评；回顾

ex.s: Will the golden word “success” form in their minds when they review our achievements?
ex.t: 当他们回顾我们的成就时，『成功』这个金光闪闪的词会在他们脑海中浮现吗？

ex.s: According to a review of evidence in a medical journal, runners live three years  61  (long) than non-runners.
ex.t: 据一份医学期刊的证据综述，跑步者比不跑步者多活三年（___61___ long）。

ex.s: Two of the authors of the review also made a study published in 2014  66  showed a mere five to 10 minutes A day of running reduced the risk of heart disease and early deaths from all  67    (cause).
ex.t: 该综述的两位作者还做了一项2014年发表的研究，___66___显示每天仅5到10分钟跑步就能降低心脏病及各种原因（___67___ cause）早逝的风险。

a lesson in which you look again at sth you have studied, especially in order to prepare for an exam （尤指为准备考试的）温习课，复习课
to carefully examine or consider sth again, especially so that you can decide if it is necessary to make changes 复查；重新考虑

ex.s: To review John’s research plans.
ex.t: 为了回顾约翰的研究计划。

defs.def: to think about past events, for example to try to understand why they happened 回顾；反思
to write a report of a book, play, film/movie, etc. in which you give your opinion of it 写（关于书籍、戏剧、电影等的）评论；评介

ex.s: To serve its function, a book must be activated by a user: the cover opened, the pages parted, the contents reviewed, perhaps notes written down or words underlined.
ex.t: 为了发挥其功能，一本书必须由使用者来激活：打开封面，翻开书页，浏览内容，也许还要写下笔记或划出字句。

ex.s: Consumers enjoy reading and giving reviews.
ex.t: 消费者喜欢阅读和撰写评价。

ex.s: The reviews were written by real people who were given information about the hotel.
ex.t: 这些评论是由真实的人写的，他们拿到了关于酒店的信息。

ex.s: Writing fake reviews will be declared illegal.
ex.t: 撰写虚假评论将被宣布为非法。

ex.s: The fake reviews written for Azimi’s study were put together by humans, but increasingly, fake reviews are being written by AI, which makes them look more real.
ex.t: Azimi研究中使用的虚假评论由真人编写，但越来越多的虚假评论正由人工智能撰写，这使它们看起来更加真实。

ex.s: Shabnam Azimi and Alexander Krasnikov of Loyola University of Chicago and Kwong Chan of Northeastern University recently published a study on fake reviews.
ex.t: 芝加哥洛约拉大学的Shabnam Azimi、Alexander Krasnikov和东北大学的Kwong Chan最近发表了一项关于虚假评论的研究。
